segments.title: Chương 82: 0082【Vĩnh Biệt Thời Trung Học】
segments.content:
The ceiling fan spun slowly, and the clothes of many examinees were already soaked with sweat.

The high temperatures started on the afternoon of the first day of the Gaokao, and the second day was muggy and hot, but it still didn't rain.

It was only morning, and it was already swelteringly hot!

From time to time, students raised their hands to wipe the sweat from their foreheads, not just from the heat, but also from anxiety.

The Gaokao and admissions reforms in the past two years also included reforms in the Gaokao's question-setting philosophy. Take the liberal arts comprehensive exam, for example. The number of questions was smaller this year, but the number of major questions had increased, and there were even ultra-large-scale comprehensive questions.

It focused more on testing the students' comprehensive abilities, guiding them to solve problems with more open-minded thinking.

This was right up Chen Guiliang's alley; this was his strong suit!

But many ordinary students were scratching their heads. They had rarely seen such ultra-large-scale questions that integrated various subjects. They not only needed to apply basic knowledge points but also had to use divergent thinking to integrate different subjects, and even link them to real-world issues to write their answers.

For example, Yang Hao from dorm room 302. He was usually very diligent, but his ability to adapt was extremely poor. At this moment, he was on the verge of crying during the exam.

After checking his paper, Chen Guiliang used his sleeve to wipe the fine sweat from his forehead.

He had already used up a whole pack of Hearttex tissues.

His seat was in the corner, quite far from the ceiling fan, and the air circulation was very poor, making it extremely uncomfortable in the muggy weather.

Never mind his shirt, even his pants were soaked with sweat!

When the exam ended, those who lived in the county town hurried home. Those staying in hotels in the county town were also eager to return to their rooms.

The boarding students from the county, like Chen Guiliang, could only go to the small eateries nearby.

Until the English exam started in the afternoon, the small eateries near the exam site were packed with people. The owners were well-prepared, temporarily adding more fans and letting the students use them for as long as they wanted.

Leaving the eatery, they rushed to the exam site.

The mugginess hadn't subsided, and the sun had gotten even stronger. Many vendors had set up stalls outside the exam site, specializing in selling Huoxiang Zhengqi Shui.

One could easily get heatstroke if not careful.

For the English listening comprehension, Chen Guiliang surprisingly understood most of it. Between educated guesses and what he knew, his answers were pretty much on the mark.

The difficulty of this paper was somewhere between the first and third mock exams.

Chen Guiliang found it quite smooth, mainly because his vocabulary had been continuously improving. From his rebirth until now, he had memorized over a thousand words. Although he had forgotten some, he could still remember at least five or six hundred.

Coupled with simple and common words, Chen Guiliang's English vocabulary was probably around a thousand words.

After all four exams were over, they gathered on the street.

While waiting for people, Chen Guiliang called Bian Guanyue, "How did you do?"

Bian Guanyue said, "I think it was okay. A Tier 2 university is definitely not a problem. I've improved especially fast this semester!"

"I hope you get into a Tier 1," Chen Guiliang said with a smile.

"That would require exceptional luck," Bian Guanyue said, also somewhat expectant, though she knew it was unlikely.

The two chatted a bit more before Xu Haibo ran over and asked, "Great Hero Chen, how do you feel?"

Chen Guiliang replied with a smile, "Not bad."

More and more classmates gathered, and Chen Guiliang said to Bian Guanyue, "I have to go. We'll talk tomorrow."

"Okay, goodbye."

"Hey, look over there," Li Yulin said, pointing at Yang Hao by the side of the road ahead.

Everyone turned to look and saw Yang Hao squatting there, his shoulders shaking as if he were sobbing.

This little brother had bombed the exam, and his spirit was broken too!

The seven brothers from dorm 302 went over to comfort him.

After a good while, Yang Hao finally stood up, wiped his tears, and forced a smile, "It's okay. I'll just repeat the year."

Although a Tier 3 university was still an undergraduate program, the tuition was too expensive for Yang Hao's family to afford. Repeating the year, on the other hand, was less costly.

Qin Shanshan had arrived at some point and said with a rather carefree smile, "Yang Hao, I'll repeat the year with you."

"Thanks," Yang Hao said, wiping his tears again.

Class president Li Rui shouted, "Class 11 of Senior Year 3, don't forget the farewell dinner! Everyone gather 'round, gather 'round. You can go on your own too, just don't forget the place: Qiu Er's Farmhouse Restaurant!"

For tonight's farewell dinner, the head teacher would definitely be there, but only two or three of the other subject teachers could come.

Liu Shuying and Gao Zhan, the couple, walked in with smiles on their faces.

Liu Shuying clapped her hands and said, "The Gaokao is over this year. You can all let loose and have fun. No need to think about estimating your scores. Just come to the school on the 27th to see your scores and fill out your university choices!"

In 2004, the Gaokao was in a transitional phase of reform, and the situation with filling out university choices was very chaotic.

In five provinces and municipalities, you had to fill out your choices before the exam.

In sixteen provinces and municipalities, you filled them out after the exam by estimating your score.

In ten provinces and municipalities, you filled them out after seeing your scores.

Sichuan province, in particular, kept changing. It was see-your-score two years ago, estimate-your-score last year, and see-your-score again this year.

Everyone took their seats, occupying several tables.

The Chinese teacher, Li Runze, arrived late. He was the type to just lie flat like a carefree spirit. Despite being a master teacher, he stubbornly refused to be a head teacher.

Chen Guiliang joked, "Mr. Li, you didn't bring your thermos today. Are you here to drink with us?"

"Sure, I'll have a few drinks," Li Runze agreed readily, no longer thinking about his goji berry tea.

Liu Shuying reminded them, "You can have beer tonight, but don't drink too much. The sober students are responsible for taking the drunk ones back!"

"Long live our head teacher!"

The boys cheered in unison.

Before all the dishes were served, the politics teacher, Gao Zhan, raised his glass and said, "I wish you all great scores and that you all get into the universities you like. Cheers!"

"Cheers!"

Sichuan girls were straightforward and bold. For the first toast, everyone drank beer; no one chose a soft drink.

Chen Guiliang received a text message. It was from Auntie Tao. He drank while texting with Tao Xue.

Li Runze was particularly fond of Chen Guiliang as a student, even sitting next to him at the farewell dinner. "How did you do this time?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Chinese is between 138 and 145. Math and English are between 100 and 125. The liberal arts comprehensive exam is probably over 250."

"That confident?" Li Runze asked in surprise.

Before the Gaokao reform, scoring 250 on the liberal arts comprehensive exam was very difficult. Even the provincial top liberal arts scholars mostly scored in the 240s.

Chen Guiliang said, "I have a pretty good idea of where I might lose points."

Xu Haibo estimated, "Doesn't that mean you could score over 600?"

"Holy crap!"

Xie Yang glumly poured a drink. "Great Hero Chen, let's have a drink."

"Bottoms up," Chen Guiliang said, raising his glass.

Xie Yang went on to toast several others in succession. After getting a bit tipsy, he mustered his courage and walked up to Zhou Jing. "Zhou Jing, I'd like to toast you too."

Zhou Jing was taken aback. She wasn't usually familiar with Xie Yang and was surprised he would switch tables just to toast her.

"Ooh-ooh-ooh~~~"

The brothers from dorm 302 all knew what was going on and immediately let out a collective, strange cheer. Even Yang Hao joined in.

Zhou Jing finally guessed Xie Yang's intentions and said with a smile, "Xie Yang, I wish you a bright future."

Xie Yang dramatically tossed his hair and said with feigned casualness, "I wish you get into a good university too!"

Zheng Feng walked up to Chen Guiliang and said in a low voice, "Take good care of her. I'll down mine, you can do as you please."

"I will," Chen Guiliang nodded.

Liu Shuying shouted, "Eat more food, drink less alcohol!"

Guan Zhiqiang finally wasn't reading a novel today. He first went to toast the teachers, then went around toasting his classmates one by one, constantly saying, "As you wish, as you wish, no need to down it, don't get drunk."

Li Jun seemed to have been isolated. No one was drinking with him, and no one was talking to him.

He ate his food sullenly, feeling more and more disgruntled.

Especially when he saw many classmates pulling Chen Guiliang over for a drink, Li Jun felt even more depressed. In a fit of anger, he grabbed two bottles of beer and went over. "Chen Guiliang, do you dare to chug these with me?"

"Are you nuts?" Chen Guiliang said, annoyed.

Liu Shuying scolded even more harshly, "Li Jun, stop acting crazy and sit back down to eat!"

This reprimand from the head teacher finally made Li Jun break down. He smashed the two beer bottles on the floor. "You all ostracize me, I'm not putting up with this today!"

After saying that, he turned and left, feeling incredibly wronged.

The whole world was wrong, the whole world was against him!

Liu Shuying's expression was extremely ugly. She called some students over to help the waitress clean the floor.

Guan Zhiqiang laughed with particular glee, "Huo-huo-huo-huo-huo-huo..."

After Li Jun left, the atmosphere became even more harmonious.

Everyone drank more and more. Fearing an accident, Liu Shuying forcibly put a stop to the drinking, having the waiters take away the beer and replace it with soft drinks.

Well-fed and well-drunk, the party came to an end.

Some students started crying, especially the girls. They would just start crying as they talked, as if today were a final, tragic parting.

Xie Yang had his arm around Chen Guiliang's shoulder, slurring drunkenly, "Remember when we first started high school in senior year one? We were assigned to the top and bottom bunks."

"I remember," Chen Guiliang said. "Your bunkmate was Fan Junfei, wasn't he? The one who bragged nonstop about getting into the Junior Writers' Association."

"You were closest with him back then. I never thought that kid would end up studying science."

"You were closest with him back then too."

"Haha, he went to internet cafes to play games even more crazily than I did, and then he started reading literature with you. That bastard, his grades could still get him into a Tier 1 university!"

"He went into seclusion to cultivate during his third year of high school. He was either studying or on his way to study. We barely ever saw him."

"..."

The whole class split into many small groups, chatting with each other about interesting stories from the past.

Seeing that it was about time, Liu Shuying went to the counter to pay the bill and urged everyone to head back quickly, telling them not to run around after drinking tonight.

As if.

The moment the teachers left, the second-generation smoker Qin Shanshan shouted, "Let's go sing KTV! It's my treat tonight!"

Li Yulin mysteriously went to find Wang Yu. Wang Yu walked out, blushing.

Chen Guiliang shouted, "Li Yulin, be safe."

Li Yulin's face also turned red in a flash. "I know!"

This young couple then disappeared, both staying out all night.

Class president Li Rui said to Chen Guiliang, "Great Hero Chen, you watch over them, don't let anything happen while they're drunk. I have to go home, sorry about this."

"No problem, you go ahead," Chen Guiliang agreed.

Chen Guiliang first asked which students were leaving and then called a few taxis. He forcibly stuffed those who had had too much to drink into the cars, pairing each with a sober student to escort them.

He even paid the taxi fare, telling the drivers to return any change.

In the end, nearly twenty people followed Qin Shanshan to the KTV.

Chen Guiliang sat in the KTV room, not singing, just lying down to sober up, while exchanging text messages with Bian Guanyue and Tao Xue.

They sang until nearly dawn. When Qin Shanshan was paying, Chen Guiliang went out again to call taxis and arrange for the students who had gotten drunk at the KTV.

"Let's go, to the internet cafe," Xie Yang could barely stand straight, yet he was still thinking about going online. He hadn't been online in two or three months.

Xu Haibo, however, acted mysteriously and pulled Chen Guiliang aside. "Great Hero Chen, do you know where I can watch yellow videos? I... I don't mean anything by it, I just want to study... you know, I'm curious."

Chen Guiliang burst out laughing. "Then let's go to the internet cafe together."

Except for Li Yulin, the other seven from dorm 302 all charged towards the internet cafe in a flurry.

The second semester of senior year had almost driven them crazy. Tonight, they seized the opportunity to let loose with all their might.

Xu Haibo chose a hidden corner. Under the guidance of the internet cafe manager, he found quite a bit of study material. He put on his headphones and watched, his face flushing red.

Chen Guiliang just collapsed in front of his computer and slept.

The other five also fell asleep not long after, having already been drunk.

Only Xu Haibo remained full of vigor.

Chen Guiliang's second high school experience thus came to a hasty end in an internet cafe.
